text_block_list.text:
It's the evening before the holiest night
of the
year... Visions of food are flashing
through my
mind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Fried chicken, turkey, meatloaf, and the
most
delectable cake...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's dinner time! We're having
oden
tonight! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: (Crash! That's the sound of Супер Крик destroying my holiday dreams.)
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Is something wrong?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: I had something else in mind...

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry. It's just that it's so cold
now.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It's almost freezing outside, so I thought
oden
would warm us up...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Today is particularly cold. Супер Крик is simply being as considerate as always.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I guess everyone really does want
to eat
cake around this time of year.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I was wondering a while back if it was
really
necessary.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Well... One time, I was helping out at my
family's
daycare center. I took one of the
kids to the
park...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I don't care if Mom comes to get
me or
not!
text_block_list.name: Boy A

text_block_list.text: I just want my cake! That's all!
text_block_list.name: Boy A

text_block_list.text:
I don't think that boy actually wanted
cake.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
He simply wanted to have a joyful
holiday dinner
with his family.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Which is why I picked oden tonight. I
thought you
might find it more
comforting.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Should I have chosen something else
instead?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: I'm more than happy with oden.

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you! Let's warm up under
the kotatsu
and eat.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
On a night when everyone else is eating
cake, for
some reason we're pecking at
oden.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But I guess this is what it means to truly
have a
connection with someone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What a great meal! Did you eat your fill,
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Glad to hear it! Now for dessert...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: I'll bring out the cake!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: (Crash! That's the sound of Супер Крик destroying my holiday woes.)
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Is something wrong?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Mmm, that was delicious!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Um, Тренер? Could I ask you one more
question?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I said before that it didn't matter what
you eat as
long as you spend the day
with the people you
care about, but...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Does that apply to all relationships?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: I'm not sure if I follow...

text_block_list.text:
Well, if we weren't trainer and
Umamusume...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Would you have wanted to spend this
occasion
with me?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I think for a while but am unable to find
an
answer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: What do you think, Супер Крик?

text_block_list.text: Me? Well... Hmm...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Who knows! I'm starting to feel like it
doesn't
matter. ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Talk about a plot twist.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The room is filled with a comfortable
warmth. I
decide to leave the
conversation at that.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
